purpose: Provide a streamed assistant conversation in a shared side sheet with explicit context snapshots and cancellation.
behaviorProvider: React asynchronous iterable handling composed with SideSheet, PromptInput and shared AI message components.

requirements.statement: Support controlled open/onOpenChange or local defaultOpen through SideSheet; closing stops the current generation.
Clone initialMessages on initial mount and snapshot attached context for each request; later initialMessages changes are not a controlled transcript replacement.
Append token events, update steps by identifier, deduplicate citations and complete or fail the active assistant response from the supplied async iterable.
Use a generation identity and AbortController to suppress superseded stream updates. Stop marks the active response stopped; unmount aborts outstanding generation.
Handle an external request with a nonblank prompt once for each request id while the panel is open. Regeneration reuses the prior user prompt and its captured context.
Expose a focusable transcript log with live announcements disabled and follow streamed content only when the reader remains near its bottom.
Supply a real streamResponse implementation for remote assistance. The default provider is a local mock; the host owns authentication, privacy, permissions and server-side cancellation.
Implement citation navigation, feedback and custom result actions. Supply valid stable message/context identifiers and persist conversations outside this local component.
Own pattern or component styling consumes ai-assistance group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No default remote model connection or durable conversation storage.
Abort prevents later UI updates but does not guarantee remote work or side effects stopped.
Controlled open state does not make the transcript controlled; initialMessages are initial data.
